sentences.text: Ravi Kant Newatia vs Unknown on 7 October, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh

88
07-10-2024
Ct. No.34 b.das Crr No. 3688 of 2024 In the matter of : Ravi Kant Newatia.
..... petitioner.

Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee Mr. Pawan Kr. Gupta Mr. Sovan Bera Ms. Puja Beriwal Ms. Sofia Nesar Mr.
S. K. Singh ...for the petitioner.

The petitioner seeks quashing of proceeding of Gr No. 2084 of 2007 including the order dated 17 th
August, 2023 passed therein by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 12th Court, Calcutta, presently
redesignated as Judicial Magistrate, 10th Court, Calcutta.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegations made out in the complaint lodged against the petitioner is almost identical to the subject matter of CS No.261 of 2007 which was settled between the parties, such settlement being recorded in an order passed on 20 th December,
2007.
The said order provided for a decree to the extent of the claim in the suit.
The order was confirmed by a co ordinate Bench of this Court on 24 th April, 2008.
The petitioner filed an application for discharging him from the complaint in view of the settlement arrived at between the parties earlier.
By the order impugned, the learned Magistrate turned down the prayer of the petitioner solely on the anvil of objection raised by the learned APP and without application of judicial mind.
The learned Magistrate has also framed charge against the petitioner on the same day under Sections 380/408/420 of the Indian Penal Code.
It appears from the material on record that the petitioner has been able to make out an arguable case.
The petitioner is directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.

Let the matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of January,
2025.
